meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Design thinking and decision-making for web UI. Use when designing components, layouts, color schemes, typography, or creating aesthetic interfaces. Teaches principles, not fixed values.

copy.tagline: 运用设计原则做出精致的网页界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为网页的布局、配色和字体而纠结
copy.tagline_en: Apply design principles to craft beautiful web interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are stuck on layout, color, or font choices

howto.what: Claude 会按设计原则来思考界面问题：先分析时间、内容、品牌、技术、受众等条件，不清楚就问用户；然后在配色、字体、布局、动效上给出符合用户心理的方案，并能避开常见的模板化设计。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计组件、布局、配色等界面元素，或要求美化网页界面时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个落地页，先分析约束条件
say.note: 它会先问时间、受众、品牌等问题

say.text: 给这个卡片配色，用蓝色系但避免深青
say.note: 它会按60-30-10配色规则给方案

say.text: 按设计原则审查我的页面排版
say.note: 它会检查布局、反模式与一致性

howto.what_en: Claude assists UI design: analyzes constraints (timeline, brand, tech, audience), asks when unclear, then gives color, typography, layout, animation choices based on UX psychology, avoiding AI clichés.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to design UI components, layouts, color schemes, or other visual aspects of a web interface.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for me; start by analyzing constraints.
say_en.note: It will ask about timeline, audience, brand, etc.

say_en.text: Give this card a blue color scheme, but avoid deep cyan.
say_en.note: It will apply the 60-30-10 rule to the palette.

say_en.text: Audit my page layout against your design principles.
say_en.note: It checks layout, anti-patterns, and consistency.
